title: A Cloud page read too large to receive keeps the owl's computer (Italian)
pins: On a Cloud owl's computer, a read-only step (the page snapshot after opening a heavy page) answers with a receipt larger than the host reads. Nothing on the computer changed, so it keeps working: the page is read as text instead, the computer is not retired, and the next step uses the same computer. From the 0.18.0 changelog: a heavy web page no longer retires a Cloud owl's computer when it is only read (cloud_desktop.reads_only).
